messages.content:
Risk: Exposing personal information
Description: When personal identifiable information (PII) or sensitive personal information (SPI) are used in training data, fine-tuning data, seed data for synthetic data generation, or as part of the prompt, models might reveal that data in the generated output. Revealing personal information is a type of data leakage.
Concern: Sharing people's PI impacts their rights and make them more vulnerable.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 5/11 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NationalIDExposure: National ID Exposure — Disclosing government-issued identification numbers such as Social Security numbers, passport numbers, or national identity card numbers. [found by 5/11 queries]
  Siblings: Photo and Likeness Exposure, Biometric Data Exposure, Name and Address Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data. [found by 5/11 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination. [found by 5/11 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#EmploymentDataExposure: Employment Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of employment information including compensation, performance evaluations, or workplace records that individuals expect to remain confidential. [found by 5/11 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure

axes.rationale: The risk specifically involves the exposure of personal identifiable information (PII) or sensitive personal information (SPI), which directly identifies individuals.
The risk involves unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information, which compromises individual privacy.
